title: Arithmetic Polyhedra
summary: The Koebe-Andreev-Thurston theorem assigns a 3-dimensional hyperbolic reflection group to each combinatorial polyhedron. A natural question is: which of them are arithmetic? In 2016, Kontorovich-Nakamura conjectured that all arithmetic reflection groups obtained in this way are commensurable to those obtained from the tetrahedron, square pyramid, or cuboctahedron. In this paper, we prove the conjecture.
